shortDescription: Run one or more commands on EdgeSwitch devices

options.name: commands
options.description: The commands or ordered set of commands that should be run against the remote device. The output of the command is returned to the playbook. If the C(wait_for) argument is provided, the module is not returned until the condition is met or the number of retries is exceeded.

options.name: interval
options.description: The number of seconds to wait between C(retries) of the command.

options.name: match
options.description: Used in conjunction with C(wait_for) to create match policy. If set to C(all), then all conditions in C(wait_for) must be met. If set to C(any), then only one condition must match.

options.name: retries
options.description: Number of times a command should be tried before it is considered failed. The command is run on the target device and evaluated against the C(wait_for) conditionals.

options.name: wait_for
options.description: Causes the task to wait for a specific condition to be met before moving forward. If the condition is not met before the specified number of retries is exceeded, the task will fail.
